seo.title: SUP board advisor — which board suits you? | [APPNAME]
seo.description: Answer a few questions (weight, experience, water type, goal) and get a personalized SUP board recommendation with prices and reviews.

wizard.title: Board advisor
wizard.lead: Five quick questions — and we'll show you which board fits you.

passenger.q: Will you take a passenger along?

water.q: Where will you paddle most often?

use.q: What will you mainly use it for?

error.invalidWeight: Enter your body weight between 30 and 200 kg to continue.
error.invalidHeight: Enter your height between 120 and 220 cm.

height.hint: Weight determines the board's volume (buoyancy), height its length — a taller paddler suits a longer board.

result.title: Your boards
